query: Hojicha roasted green tea lower caffeine nutty toasty

results.content: ... tea leaves are brown wedge-shaped needles. The tea is fired at a high temperature, altering the leaf colour tints from green to reddish-brown. Infusions have a distinctive clear red appearance and nutty fragrance. Hojicha is sometimes sold in a powdered form and used to make steamed milk drinks. Taste Once infused, hōjicha has a nutty, toasty, sweet flavor. The tea has little to no bitterness.
